description: You are a Content Marketing Manager at an online bookstore. You need to identify book descriptions that are difficult to read. Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to calculate 'Readability' metrics (specifically Flesch Reading Ease), then crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'. After the crawl, export the Content analysis data to a CSV file at '~/Documents/SEO/exports/readability_audit.csv'. Finally, create a text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/hardest_to_read.txt' containing the URL of the page with the lowest Flesch Reading Ease score.
